related_questions.question: Why are property taxes so high in Corpus Christi, TX?
related_questions.snippet: One of the primary factors behind high property taxes in Texas is the absence of a state income tax. Unlike other states that collect income taxes to fund public services and infrastructure, Texas relies heavily on property taxes as a primary source of revenue.

related_questions.question: Is a tax appraisal the same as a home appraisal?
related_questions.snippet: Appraisals and assessments both determine a home's value, but they serve different purposes. An assessment affects your property taxes, while an appraisal impacts home sales and refinancing. Understanding how each one influences your home's value can help you make informed financial decisions.
